blocks.html: Makeup air ducts connecting to or within 18 inches (457.2 mm) of a Type I hood shall be constructed and installed in accordance with Sections 603.1, 603.3, 603.4, 603.9, 603.10, and 603.12. Duct insulation installed within 18 inches (457.2 mm) of a Type I hood shall be noncombustible or shall be listed for the application.
